overall: The AG found the Commission did not justify continued withholding of the June 22, 2020 executive session minutes, since its Purpose 1 purpose had concluded; ordered release unless privilege or a Public Records exemption applies, and referred the records question to the Supervisor of Records.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to release its June 22, 2020 executive session minutes after the purpose for the executive session had concluded.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission has failed to satisfy its burden of justifying that the purpose for the executive session is ongoing.

remedy: Release the minutes of the June 22, 2020 executive session meeting, unless the attorney-client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
remedy_passage: For the reasons stated above, we order the Commission to release the minutes of the June 22, 2020, executive session meeting, unless the attorney-client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
